title: 50 API Interview Questions
summary: The 50 most asked backend/SDE API interview questions, from REST and HTTP basics through auth, security, pagination, rate limiting, caching, webhooks, versioning, gateways and real-world design scenarios. Each page gives 3-4 questions with short answers, key points and a visual.

chapters.title: 50 API Interview Questions
points: REST, HTTP methods and status codes
Authentication: JWT and OAuth 2.0
CORS and API security
Pagination, rate limiting and caching
Webhooks, idempotency, versioning and uploads
Gateway, testing, monitoring and design scenarios

points: What is a REST API and what are its constraints?

chapters.title: HTTP Methods and Safety
points: What is the difference between GET and POST?

chapters.title: Status Codes That Get Asked

What do 429, 502, 503 and 504 mean?

chapters.title: JWT and Session Authentication
points: What is a JWT and how is it structured?

chapters.title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect

chapters.title: CORS and API Security

chapters.title: Pagination, Filtering and Sorting

chapters.title: Webhooks and Idempotency

chapters.title: Versioning and File Uploads
points: How do you version a REST API?

chapters.title: Gateway, Testing and Monitoring
points: What does an API gateway do?
What is the difference between an API gateway and a load balancer?

chapters.title: Scalability and Design Scenarios
points: How do you scale an API to handle 10x traffic?

How would you design a payment API that never double-charges?
